ops.title: First lockstep release: crates.io bootstrap + tag rehearsal for Go/Rust bindings
ops.description:
Once the Go/Rust bindings land on main (CI green incl. wasm-fresh), execute the first lockstep release per the architecture note [Go/Rust bindings architecture]:

1. One-time crates.io bootstrap: publish `spawnllm-core` then `spawnllm` with a classic API token (trusted publishers can only be registered on EXISTING crates); both names verified free 2026-07-18.
2. Register trusted publishers for both crates: repo yasyf/spawnllm, workflow `release-crates.yml`, environment `crates-io`; then delete the classic token.
3. Push the next `v*` tag and confirm: PyPI publish (existing flow), crates.io publish via OIDC, `go/vX.Y.Z` alias tag auto-minted, `go get github.com/yasyf/spawnllm/go@vX.Y.Z` resolves via proxy.golang.org, docs.rs builds green, pkg.go.dev renders go/README.md.
4. Partial-release policy: fix forward with the next patch tag, never retag.

ops.text: spawnllm and spawnllm-core live on crates.io with trusted publishing registered and the classic token deleted
a single v* tag produced PyPI + crates.io releases and a go/vX.Y.Z alias tag on the same commit
go get github.com/yasyf/spawnllm/go@vX.Y.Z resolves and docs.rs build is green
